notes.title: NEW MAJOR UPDATE - 2.00 Update is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello, guys!

This is an update dedicated to the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty release later today. It includes all the fixes and improvements we did to the core mechanics while working on Strategic Mind. This is just one in a series of updates aimed at polish and post-launch support of the entire series.

Today, we addressed one of the series issues that was especially noticeable if you own all Strategic Mind titles - we reduced the disk space required for all games in the series. So, now it is easier to store them. 

Update 2.00


 The game now requires less disk space (Before 41.1 GB | Now 38.2 GB)
 (For other SM titles we managed to reduce size by 20-35%, but here it worked the least. We will see if we could further improve in that direction, as it is right now the largest build among Strategic Mind titles.)
 Fixed various bugs while working on Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty
 Fixed some localization errors
 More fixes to come soon


Non-exhaustive list of fixed issues:


 Bug with “flying” Recon unit
 3rd equipment slot abuse for some units. 
 The torpedo sound could still be heard when the volume is at 0.
 Units not getting extra EXP for capturing enemies that could not retreat due to various reasons. 
 Units keeping bonus from aura effects, even if the UNDO button returned the aura-giving unit away from them
 Abuse that allowed to return units to Reserve outside of the Deployment area.
 [Fight for Freedom only] Fixed the Sniper Squad (USA) equipment not providing +1 Spotting. 
 The crash caused by the illegitimate equipping of units outside the Service Zone (Which was possible due to a UI bug). 


All other Strategic Mind titles are also receiving a similar update today. 

You can expect more updates and quality-of-life improvements as we keep polishing the series and provide post-launch support for Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty and other titles. All relevant improvements will be delivered across all titles of the Strategic Mind series, as always. 

As today, with the beginning of the Steam Strategy Fest, we celebrate the release of Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty, you can take advantage of the special offer - all owners of the previous Strategic Mind series games can get the newest title with 15% extra discount on top of the existing launch discount. Act now, commander!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34509/

With best regards
Starni Games team

notes.title: A massive missile strike against Ukraine - 10th October 2022 Dev update
notes.notes:
Hello

We are here today with an urgent report about the massive missile attack against cities all over Ukraine, including the capital Kyiv, where our team is located. This is how the day started for us:


Part of the team was already in the office, while other were getting ready to go to work or en route, when the first missiles hit Kyiv in the morning of October 10th. That was followed with several more rounds of attack. Overall, it was reported that 83 missiles of different types (43 shot down by AA defenses) and some kamikaze drones (some say 9 out of 10 destroyed by AA) were deployed in this attack. 

We decided that everyone could work from home, although some people were already at the office. That came in handy, as subway stopped for a few hours. 

As a person who lives in Kyiv my whole life and knows the city quite well, I can tell you that most places of the reported attacks does not make any sense in terms of military logic - its just some parks, squares or cars in the middle of the street, some tourist places as well. Nothing like an important military target, or even government building… The only explanation to that could be that the aim of these attacks is terror of civilians and an attempt to sow panic and chaos. 

Yet, some strikes did hit some power plants across the country, causing power shortages in several large cities (but not in Kyiv). Right now, I am writing this news update in my apartments in Kyiv, not knowing where the next Russian missiles would land…

Ukraine War Stories tells the story of the first month of the war. It would take more than one game to tell the story of this entire war… Still, if you want to know how everything started for the civilian people of Ukraine back in February - join us for the full release of our free title on 18 October 2022. 

The story of this war is far from over. Stand united, support Ukraine! 

With Best Regards from Kyiv
Oleksandr and the Starni Games team

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
Hello, guys!

Three weeks have passed since release and we have been hard at work fixing all sorts of issues reported by the players’ community. Now, we can say that we are 90% through, and we present most of the remaining fixes in today’s update. 

Update 1.05

Bug fixes:

 Fixed serious issue with the secondary objective in Battle of the Bulge. The enemy airforce damage counter was working incorrectly leading to a likely failure. Now that is fixed. It will work correctly from the save file, but the already counted value will remain. So, you might want to go back a couple of turns. (Reported by: mmtt)
 Fixed the Poor morale effect on the German air force (after completing the objective during Battle of the Bulge) to carry over to the USSR air force. If you already have this effect you have to finish any of the operations 5, 6, 7, 8, or 9 to get rid of it. (Reported by: Foxador)
 Fixed Searchlight Control "Elsie" in multiple ways. (Reported by: VirgoCompany and others)
 1) Now it cannot be installed together with other Radar and/or searchlights. 
 2) Now it does not provide a +2 Air attack regardless of the day/night time. 
 3) Its cost was lowered from 110 to 80 Prestige.
 4) Now it combines Radar and Heavy searchlight effect, but takes only 1 equipment slot (as was originally designed). So, It both reduces the Night attack penalty by 50% and adds a +3 Air attack ONLY at Night. 
 Added missing Victory hexes counter in the primary objective of Battle for Moscow. 


Description updates:

 Corrected Battle of the Bulge operation briefing to inform about the Winter operation. (Reported by: Foxador)
 Corrected Sniper squad equipment description.
 Corrected Small searchlight description. (Reported by: VirgoCompany)
 Corrected Medium searchlight description. (Reported by: VirgoCompany)
 Corrected Heavy searchlight description. (Reported by: VirgoCompany)
 Corrected Searchlight Control "Elsie" description.
 Corrected Radio combat support skill (Hero Audie Murphy) description. (Reported by: Foxador)
 Added Last stand effect description. 


Visual improvements

 Replaced V-1 models with V-2 models and correct launch pads in the secondary objectives hexes in operation Market Garden. 


As you can see, most of the issues were reported by you guys, so your reports and feedback help us a lot. Right now, we have fixed most of the serious issues, but we will keep polishing and improving the game. Make sure you report any problems you face to our team on the community hub, or reach out to us by email: contact@starnigames.com

With best regards
Starni Games team

notes.title: 8 Days to Release - Douglas A-1 Skyraider The US Attack Aircraft
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/735bfbb3c9f0ef7335b2984bba27902e6dad1c28.png

In the age of the turbojet, Douglas A-1 Skyraider flew as a piston-powered, propeller-driven blast from the past. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/12bda2c534d744d6812578cee65c8d21ee4a0737.jpg

With the rapid development of jet aircraft towards the end of the war, dozens, if not hundreds of piston engine aircraft became obsolete. The Skyraider could have joined their lot, but its innovative turbo-compound engine gave it a chance to prove itself - and prove itself it did.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/500fbb2065c7709ed3a10144dbf984b50aac36e8.jpg

A solid, well-made and innovative at a time, Douglas A-1 would last well into the Vietnam War, only decommissioned in the 1970s. It was an attack aircraft that could shred ground targets with its 20-mm autocannons, carry out tactical bombings (with its payload capacity of 3600 kg) and deliver torpedo strikes equally well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/474ae69218b59df3733695829d035bdb30e3b894.jpg

There is no telling how effective Douglas A-1 would have been in WWII if it were finalized and deployed faster. And in Fight for Freedom, you’ll get to explore that exact possibility.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38607672/5118c29e7556e9dbbae33d83f371a28db1a6c3fd.png

Victory in Europe Day

General! We would like to celebrate V-E Day by uploading a new Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom Demo build for free. So, now everyone can enjoy the game and live through the epochal events, such as the Normandy landings.

We are immensely grateful to all the valiant soldiers who fought in WW2 and brought the World age of peace and prosperity. Now, we can see the horrors of massive conflicts only in games, and we get to choose which games to play. We think there is a lot to be learned about our society and human nature in general by studying the events of WW2 - and what better way of immersing oneself in these events than to become an active participant, even if only in the game. 

The New Demo

The new Demo has around 5 hours of gameplay - the first operations of both the UK and the US campaigns. Overall the build runs great and there should not be any serious technical issues. There is some stuff that we still have to iron out, especially in localizations and cinematics, so the most vigilant players may notice some issues, but we are working day and night to correct everything before release, so do not worry - we will do our best to correct all possible shortcomings. In fact, if you notice anything weird - make sure to let us know at our community hub - and we will do our best to fix it asap. 

The Game Release - 21 May

The full game will be released on 21 May 2021, so there are only two weeks left. Wishlist Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom, so that you do not miss its launch. 

📍 Important notes: 
 You can use Demo save files when you play the full game. So, you could covert your Demo progress into a full game on its full launch on 21 May.
 You can post any materials without restrictions.

👉 Play the Demo by following this link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381850?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=demo_update
Have a good weekend!

Starni Games team

notes.title: Story Trailer - Release Date Announcement! Strategic Mind Titles Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ol8CWwA2qvI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, guys! Today, we are proud to announce that Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom will be released on 21 May 2021. 

“We are happy to announce the release date for Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom. When we started working on the Strategic Mind series back in 2018 our goal was to cover all major powers in WW2, and now we are finally close to that goal.” - says Ihor Tymoshenko, the CEO of Starni Games.

Free Demo Update
We know that you have been waiting for it, and want it to released as soon as possible, so to make your wait more pleasant we will update the Free Demo for the game on 8 May 2021 - Victory in Europe Day - so that you will be able to play the first operations of both UK and USA campaigns for free with sound and cinematics. We hope that it will keep you occupied until the full release comes on 21 May and will be a great celebration of the civilized world victory in WW2. 

All Strategic Mind series titles update
Additionally, all our previous Strategic Mind titles are getting an overhaul to be compatible with the upcoming Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom - which includes upgraded tutorials, bug fixes, and other quality of life improvements. The update is planned for the last days of April. 

Let’s turn May 2021 into a wargamer’s holiday!
We hope that we can turn the preparations for the release into a true wargamer’s holiday with lots of stuff going on both in terms of news about the upcoming Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom and in terms of the content available to you throughout the next month. 

Community support matters
Please, let us know your thoughts in the comments! We have already implemented lots of features based on community feedback and will keep doing so to the best of our ability. Thus, you can be sure that your voice matters and all you need to do is give us meaningful feedback and wait for us to implement your suggestion. Together we can build the best wargame possible. 

Do not miss it
Make sure you wishlist and follow Strategic Mind: Fight for Freedom to stay up to date with all the upcoming announcements:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1381850?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=community&utm_medium=web

Subscribe to our newsletter to gain exclusive wallpapers and other good stuff by the end of April. Subscribe to newsletter here.
